Installation
============

Requirements
------------

``spinanalysis`` requires Python 3.13 or newer. ``uv`` or ``pip`` is required
to install the package.

Installation Commands
---------------------

The following commands cover the common installation use cases:

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 20 40 40

   * - 
     - uv
     - pip
   * - User
     - ``uv add spinanalysis``
     - ``pip install spinanalysis``
   * - Developer
     - ``uv sync --dev``
     - ``pip install -e .``
